item.title: Circle received a limited purpose trust charter from NYDFS, enabling digital asset custody and fiduciary services in New York.
US stablecoin rulemaking remained unfinished one year after the GENIUS Act signing, with OCC and FDIC proposals still out for comment.
SEC is expected to propose rules covering crypto token offerings, broker-dealer custody frameworks, and digital asset trading venues.
Morgan Stanley received preliminary OCC approval to establish a national trust bank for digital asset custody, staking and collateral.
Tether's USDT faces a two-year compliance window under the GENIUS Act, with uncertainty remaining over when foreign-issuer deadlines apply.
OCC draft rules would require stablecoin issuers to submit weekly reserve disclosures under the GENIUS Act regulatory framework.
BNY Mellon began providing institutional clients with USDC custody, minting, and redemption services through an expanded Circle agreement.
Morgan Stanley launched a Stablecoin Reserves Portfolio to manage reserve assets for regulated stablecoin issuers.
US spot bitcoin ETFs recorded net inflows of $205M in July, the lowest monthly total since the products launched in January 2024.
Bitcoin spot ETFs recorded a third consecutive week of net inflows through July 25 despite $465M in late-week selling.
Morgan Stanley executives said the traditional 9-to-5 banking day is ending as markets shift toward 24/7 trading and settlement.
Crypto losses exceeded $1B in H1 2026 across 212 security incidents, with Ethereum and Solana sustaining the largest network losses.
EU officials began reviewing MiCA's stablecoin provisions three years after the law took effect, citing new global regulatory developments.
SEC proposed rescinding the NMS trade-through rule to facilitate blockchain-based trading venues and 24/7 settlement infrastructure.
